title: Apple Picking Near Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Choose the day before the farm.** Of the five pick-your-own orchards around Berlin with apples on the trees this September, **only two pick on a Monday** (Obstgut Marquardt and Selbstpflücke Elisenau) and **all five only at the weekend**. Hours were checked on each farm's own page on 18 September 2026.

**Your ABC ticket covers four of the five.** The VBB puts Satzkorn and Bornim in Potsdam, Elisenau, Bernau, Strausberg and Wesendahl inside **Berlin C**. The exception is **Glindow**: Werder (Havel) station is in the ABC area, the Lindicke orchard beyond it is not. A Deutschlandticket covers all five.

**Potsdam is the weekend side, Elisenau the weekday one.** Neumann's Erntegarten in Bornim is about **70 minutes** from Hauptbahnhof at the weekend, with a **3 euro** entry and the gate open from **12:00**. Elisenau is **45 minutes** from Ostkreuz on a weekday, but at the weekend its bus stops and the last **1.7 km** is on foot.

**Wesendahl is a weekday trip by bus.** Bio Apfelhof Müller opens Tuesday to Sunday, but at the weekend part of the bus service runs as the **R931 call bus**, booked by phone at least **90 minutes** ahead.

**Only Lindicke publishes prices:** **2.20 euro a kilo** up to 10 kg, windfalls **0.75**, cards accepted. For 19 and 20 September it lists **Elstar, Boskoop, Rubinette, Topaz and Sonnenglanz**, with Pinova and Jonagold from 26 September.

**My move:** on a weekday, Elisenau from Ostkreuz or Hauptbahnhof; at the weekend, Potsdam, with Marquardt from the west of the city and Neumann's from the centre. Open the farm's own page on the morning you go, because hours change week by week and rain closes fields.
